import subprocess,time
for w in ['sig_page_below','exhibit_page']:
    t=time.time()
    r=subprocess.run(['/root/work/sign-product/send-venv/bin/python','/tmp/r29rev/q3.py',w],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=280,cwd='/tmp/r29rev')
    print('#####',w,'rc',r.returncode,round(time.time()-t)); print(r.stdout[-3000:]); print(r.stderr[-1200:])
